name: 70117 · New Orleans, LA
findings: ZIP 70117 (New Orleans) has 186 nonprofit organizations. 72 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 55 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 70117 (New Orleans) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
